values.title: Seeking Jannah (Heaven)
values.description: Faith in the Creator and the afterlife guides me. Remembering death keeps my priorities clear. “Every soul shall taste death.”

values.title: Workaholic
values.description: Time disappears when I’m building something meaningful. Work is my flow state, especially when it makes an impact.

values.title: Minimalism
values.description: Simple living, staying down to earth, and being present matter to me. So do quiet moments.

values.title: Active listener
values.description: Listening to and sharing stories energize my soul. I mentor others weekly and learn from my own mentors and coaches.

values.title: Believe in connection
values.description: My net worth is in the people in my phonebook.

values.title: Monk life
values.description: Inside, I picture myself as a monk in white, with a bald head, quietly observing nature.

values.title: Growth mindset
values.description: Life feels empty when I stop learning. Sometimes I wish I had a second brain to hold it all.

values.title: Guardian of my galaxy
values.description: I have a son, a daughter, and an amazing family. They are my galaxy.

values.title: ENFP personality
values.description: Search “ENFP.” You’ll get a good picture of me.

ventures.name: GHL MegaMinds
ventures.description: My newest venture, and where most of my time goes. As a GoHighLevel Certified Admin, I lead a team helping agencies and business owners connect their marketing, sales, and follow-up.

ventures.name: Themefisher
ventures.description: I started this website-template business alone, handling design, development, and sales. It taught me how to find customers, grow a team, and build a business beyond the code.

ventures.name: UIHut
ventures.description: UIHut helps designers and developers create faster with ready-to-use design resources. I acquired the business, adding a different chapter to my journey—not everything has to start from scratch.

ventures.name: Zeon Studio
ventures.description: My team and I design and build websites for other businesses. This is where we bring our experience from building our own products into client projects.

ventures.name: SitePins
ventures.description: We built SitePins to solve our own problem: updating website content without depending on developers. Now it helps other teams manage their content without touching code.
